payload.topicTitle: Scale Disruption & Surreal Street Art: The Jacquemus Strategy
payload.hookHeadline: the jacquemus secret: scale disruption in public streets.

slides.header: the jacquemus secret: scale disruption in public streets.
slides.subhead: How turning giant luxury handbags into public streetcars generated 50M views with zero ad spend.

slides.header: why clean studio product renders are invisible.
slides.subhead: When everything is clean, perfect, and isolated on a white screen, your brain ignores it.
bodyBullets: Studio renders look like ordinary catalog advertisements
Our brains are wired to notice things that look out of place in the real world
Putting luxury inside brutalist concrete streets creates instant thumb-stopping contrast
slides.keyCallout: RULE: Contrast creates curiosity, and curiosity creates millions of organic shares.

slides.subhead: Take one small physical luxury item and scale it up to the size of a building or bus.
bodyBullets: A 5-inch lipstick turned into a 20-foot city transit bus
A luxury handbag floating down the Seine river like a giant boat
Keep the material, leather grain, and stitching 100% physically authentic
slides.keyCallout: SCALE RULE: Extreme surreal scale + 100% real physical texture = viral magic.

slides.subhead: Anchor the impossible object inside mundane, everyday physical architecture.
bodyBullets: Paris cobblestone streets, London rainy crosswalks, brutalist concrete tunnels
Include real background elements: pedestrians walking, streetlights, asphalt reflections
The contrast between gritty streets and immaculate luxury creates high prestige
slides.keyCallout: ENVIRONMENT RULE: The more ordinary the street, the more shocking the luxury object.

slides.subhead: Shoot the scene from a realistic human perspective, not a floating drone.
bodyBullets: Eye-level handheld camera with subtle natural shake
Casual street bystander angle makes the scene feel like a real iPhone recording
When viewers think "Is that real?!", they comment, share, and tag their friends
slides.keyCallout: PERSPECTIVE RULE: Bystander angle turns a CGI render into a trending viral moment.

slides.subhead: Save this exact scale-disruption prompt formula for Nano Banana & Higgsfield:
bodyBullets: 🏢 Object: "Giant 20-foot monolithic luxury perfume bottle driving down rainy Paris street"
🌧️ Lighting: "Overcast moody sky, wet asphalt reflections, raking golden street lamps"
📱 Camera: "Eye-level 50mm handheld bystander perspective, natural camera shake"
🧪 Finish: "Authentic glass refraction, real rainwater physics, 35mm film grain"
slides.keyCallout: 💾 SAVE THIS POST: Use this formula whenever you launch a physical product campaign!

slides.subhead: How to turn viral street attention into tracked brand sales:
bodyBullets: 1. Scale Disruption Video: 15s surreal street video stops the algorithm
2. Viral Comment Loop: Viewers debate "Is this real?" in the comments
3. Automated DM Playbook: Sends private shop link to everyone who comments
slides.keyCallout: ✈️ SHARE WITH A BRAND FOUNDER: Show them how to get millions of views with zero ad spend!
